Little Shop of Horrors
Runs Sep 12 - Oct 25, 2026
Book & Lyrics by Howard Ashman
Music by Alan Menken
Based on the film by Roger Corman, Screenplay by Charles Griffith
Directed by Ben Villegas Randle
Musical Direction by Jad Bernardo
Choreography by Leslie Waggoner
The killer classic comes to NCTC with an even bigger bite. Dorky shop clerk Seymour has invented a new species of plant with an appetite for one thing only: human blood. Suddenly, he's got everything he’s ever wanted, but now he must decide how far he’s willing to grow- sorry, go.
